verdict.rationale: Airbyte documents an API for programmatic access (docs-3, docs-18, docs-46) and access tokens (docs-17), but there is no evidence of API versioning scheme or a documented deprecation policy; a probe for an OpenAPI spec even returned 404s. A community comment notes an entire platform (white-label) being deprecated with apparently little formal process (airbyte-comm-8), which is the opposite of a documented deprecation policy.
